results.title: Jenson Button weighs in on ‘difficult decision’ Fernando Alonso faces on F1 future
results.description: Jenson Button has weighed in on the ongoing rumour mill surrounding the future of Fernando Alonso in Formula 1, hinting of hope the Spaniard will stay on amid what is a "difficult" decision.
